title: 第417章 人皇后裔第416章 大纵横术
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
第417章：人皇后裔
二十六门绝世神通齐出！
大祈愿术，大愿听术，大心愿术，大愿望术，聆愿观天术，安世承愿术，涤厄清愿术，纳运聚愿术，延生蓄愿术，守魂固愿术，破障释愿术，消灾解愿术……
愿力层层铺开！
姬浩脸色剧变，
“不可能！”
他只觉得自己的二十四门大纵横术如同泥牛入海！
纵横之道，
贵在分化、搅乱、虚实不定。
可是，
如今却被一道：“世间诸乱皆逢愿，万种横逆尽归安，唇舌翻覆非真道，一愿平澜镇百端！”的宏愿所镇住！
翻不出半点风浪！
这让姬浩难以接受，
他赖以成名的神通，
竟然也会被压制！
“啊啊啊这不可能……给我破！”
姬浩嘶吼一声，
全力催动大纵横术，
无数神通道掌影铺天盖地砸向愿力结界。
可愿力结界波澜不惊，

所有攻势都被温柔却坚定地化解开来。
陈默再抬手，
“星穹镇世印，餐山吞日月！”
两大绝世神通，
一化作星辰，一化作饕餮，
直奔姬浩而去！
姬浩大纵横术被压制，
避无可避，
瞬间被神通穿透身体，吞掉法力，镇住神魂本源！
噗通一声。
姬浩浑身神通尽废，
直直从空中坠落，
被陈默隔空摄住，
稳稳擒在手中。
一招，生擒！
全场死寂。
楚沧澜脸上的喜色还没褪去，就僵在了原地。
姬家人，
就这么被拿下了？
content_en:
Chapter 417: Descendants of Human Queens
Twenty-six peerless magical powers come out at once!
Great Prayer Technique, Great Wish Hearing Technique, Great Wish Technique, Great Wish Technique, Listen to Wish and Observe Heaven Technique, Peaceful World and Carrying Wish Technique, Clear Wish from Disasters, Gather Luck and Gather Wish Technique, Extend Life and Accumulate Wish Technique, Keep Soul and Solidify Wish Technique, Break Obstacles and Release Wish Technique, Eliminate Disasters and Clear Wish Technique...
May the power be spread layer by layer!
Ji Hao's expression changed drastically,
"Impossible!"
He only felt that his twenty-four great vertical and horizontal arts were like a mud cow sinking into the sea!
The vertical and horizontal road,
The key lies in differentiation, confusion, and uncertainty.
However,
Now, he is restrained by the grand wish: "All the chaos in the world will be fulfilled, all kinds of rebellion will be restored to peace, and the words and tongues will turn against the true way. One wish will calm down all the troubles!"
There's no way to cause any trouble!
This was hard for Ji Hao to accept.
The magical power for which he is famous,
Even be suppressed!
"Ah ah ah this is impossible...let me break it!"
Ji Hao roared,
Use all your strength to activate the great vertical and horizontal technique,
The palm shadows of countless divine passages smashed towards the wish barrier.
I hope the force barrier remains calm,
All attacks were resolved gently but firmly.
Chen Mo raised his hand again,
"The starry sky holds the seal of the world, and the mountain swallows the sun and the moon!"
Two peerless magical powers,
One turned into stars, the other turned into gluttons,
Go straight to Ji Hao!
Ji Hao's great vertical and horizontal skills were suppressed,
There is no way to avoid it,
In an instant, the magical power penetrates the body, swallows the mana, and suppresses the origin of the soul!
There was a pop.
Ji Hao's magical powers were all gone.
Falling straight from the sky,
Photographed by Chen Mo from the air,
Securely in hand.
One move, captured alive!
The whole place was dead silent.
Before the joy on Chu Canglan's face faded, she froze in place.
Ji family,
Was it taken down just like that?
